decision.why: The same recording passes on the reference build with this saved data and on the target build in a clean browser, and fails on the target build only with the data the reference build saved (at a check). A clean test run cannot see this bug.
decision.next: Fix the app so it opens data saved by the earlier build (for example a migration). Do not edit the test or clear the saved data.

label.rootCause: The app remained on the Files screen and did not show the expected budget view after loading.
